about_the_game:
Astro Felix is a fast paced endless skate adventure where you play as Felix, the universe’s coolest cat on four wheels! Dash through the vibrant cyber city, dodge deadly obstacles, outsmart enemies, and collect coins and power-ups to boost your run. This platformer will test your reflexes and charm your heart. 

From Home Cat to Pixel Hero
Astro Felix started as an experimental passion project based on a real cat, our beloved real life companion! His quirky behavior, skate-like slides across the floor, and curious nature inspired us to turn him into a pixel legend. 

Features

  •  Fast-paced 2D gameplay

  •  Cute and quirky space cat protagonist (Yes actually based on our real life cat.)

  •  Avoid enemies

  •  Collect coins and powerful pickups

  •  Gamepad and keyboard support

  •  Pure arcade fun with a unique twist

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-6100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated (Intel HD 530) or dedicated GPU (GeForce GTX 650 or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 / Radeon RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

short_description: Skate, jump, and claw your way through endless chaos! Astro Felix is a fast-paced, endless, retro-style platformer starring a fearless space cat on skating wheels.
